newsitem.title: USA: Avatar sells non-core assets for $15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Avatar sells non-core assets for $15 mln.

text.p: Avatar Holdings Inc said on Monday it had non-strategic assets sales of about $15 million in December.
The company said it sold about 3,100 lots at Leisure Lakes in south central Florida to the Nature Conservancy and the state of Florida for about $4.6 million.
It sold the Central Arizona Project water right entitlements of Avatar's Rio Rico utilities to the city of Scottsdale, Ariz., for about $2.1 million, Avatar said.
It sold the golf course and other assets at the Barefoot Bay community on Florida's east coast to the Barefoot Bay Recreation District for about $8.3 million, it said.
The company said the sales were part of a previously announced plan to divest non-strategic assets.
